name: relief
description: Delight from a lessening of physical or mental pain.

variations.name: physical relief
variations.description: If the pain was physical, we generally expect it to get better on its own but often still seek to speed the results with medicine. Either way, a lack of pain may come with gratitude until we get used to feeling good again.

variations.name: mental relief
variations.description: We seek psychological relief in chemical substances or various forms of escape. There are many forms of mental medicine even if we don't recognize them as such.

variations.name: relief attributed to something or someone
variations.description: If the relief is perceived as having come from a certain place or person, we may feel gratitude.

commentaries.quote: We often don't understand our psychological pain and may not know how to deal it. It may help to have a basic mental 'first aid kit' that works for you, whether that's prayer, meditation, family time, or another healthy activity.
Time only helps heal if you take care of yourself consistently. That goes for mental pain as for physical.

conditions: Self perceives that a source of pain has gotten less severe.
